title: Retire the fence's knowledge concept and supersede its decisions
action: Per D7 and D8, retire the fence from the knowledge and decision layers. KNOWLEDGE: (1) delete docs/knowledge/areas/verify-pipeline/skill-body-budget-fence.md (70 lines) -- the knowledge bundle is the STATE layer describing what IS, so a concept describing a deleted gate is false, not historical; it declares no anchors and its only inbound link is the generated index. (2) docs/knowledge/areas/doctrine-layer/placement-and-anchoring.md:209-214 states the deleted thresholds as live fact ('Standing-sheet size fence (R5): scripts/tests/test_agents_budget.mjs -- WARN_BYTES 14000 and HARD_FAIL_BYTES 15000'). That became false when the thresholds were removed; correct it to describe what that suite now guards -- the 17-rule roster and the byte-identical render -- with no size figures. (3) run node .bee/bin/bee.mjs knowledge index, which regenerates every area index AND the root docs/knowledge/index.md. NEVER hand-edit either. DECISIONS: bee decisions supersede has NO clause mode -- its parameters are id, decision, rationale, tags, scope, json, and the superseded decision drops out of the active set WHOLE. So a partial retirement is executed as: supersede wholesale, and RESTATE THE SURVIVING CLAUSE VERBATIM inside the new --decision text. There is also no --replaces/--cites flag, so the citation of repo decision 8f63adb4 lives in the --rationale prose. docs/decisions/taxonomy.json exists so every event needs at least one tag: omit --tags to inherit the target's, and pass tags explicitly only if a target carries none. Supersede these seven: c4c17668 (skill-token-diet D1, byte budget <=8192) wholesale; 6d6c6a98 (D2, grandfather + ratchet) wholesale; 5a1b3228 (D5, one in one out) wholesale; f1c259c3 (D6, baseline JSON + blocking fence) wholesale; 27fb6302 (validation D1/D2, baseline re-seed + explicit migrated array) wholesale; cb78ad77 (D8, provenance exile + grep) wholesale BUT the replacing text must RESTATE THAT THE PLACEMENT CONVENTION SURVIVES -- provenance still lives in references/provenance.md and nothing is merged back into any skill body -- because 14 provenance.md files still cite it and must stay accurate; 4a247bb6 (D3, source-byte measurement) wholesale BUT the replacing text must RESTATE THE SURVIVING HALF and drop only the clause 'the fence measures source bytes ... render-time stripping does not relieve the budget'. FINALLY run node .bee/bin/bee.mjs decisions render -- docs/decisions/index.md declares itself GENERATED from the store and no chain suite catches its staleness. NOTE it is ALREADY red before you start, from two decisions logged earlier in this feature; your render clears that too, so do not read the pre-existing red as your own regression.

truths: No knowledge concept states a byte threshold on instruction text as live fact
All seven skill-token-diet decisions are superseded, with the two partial ones restating their surviving clauses verbatim in the replacing decision text

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --only knowledge && node scripts/okf_migrate.mjs --check doctrine-layer && node scripts/okf_migrate.mjs --check verify-pipeline && node .bee/bin/bee.mjs decisions render --check

trace.outcome: Deleted the fence's knowledge concept, corrected the stale threshold reference in placement-and-anchoring.md, regenerated the knowledge indexes, and superseded all seven skill-token-diet decisions (two with their surviving clauses restated verbatim).
